note: Pedestrian routes for city walks, fetched once from FOSSGIS's public Valhalla (OpenStreetMap community instance, no key) and cached here so no visitor's browser ever calls a routing service. Keyed by city slug plus the walk's ordered tree ids, so a changed walk re-routes by itself. 'rejected' marks a route more than 2.5x longer than the straight line, which usually means a path is missing from OSM inside a park; the build falls back to the honest straight line for those.
